data.gender_notes: Fouzhan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fuzunah', which means 'to be wise, knowledgeable, and powerful'. In Islamic tradition, the name Fouzhan is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's companions and their unwavering courage and strength. The name Fouzhan carries the meaning “Victorious, Able, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fouzhan usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, able, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
